scientific_integrity: The exact positive two-view minimax value and unique optimizer follow from a two-sided analytic argument. The norm reduction and quadratic endpoint are credited to An; the sign comparison is recorded as a consequence of prior order-four phase-moment monotonicity.
scientific_limitations: Fixed normalized positive rules on one or two planar projective directions, with real p>2. No signed, larger-node, adaptive or higher-dimensional result is asserted. The convex-body supremum need not be attained by a full-dimensional body.
title: Sharp positive two-view minimax for superquadratic planar brightness
